exact.Vos projets d’origine ne sont jamais mod: Your original projects are never modified. Copies carry [ReAble] in their name.
exact.Quel dossier de projets analyser ?: Which project folder should be analyzed?
exact.Glissez un dossier ici, ou choisissez-le: Drop a folder here, or pick one. ReAble looks for Ableton Live projects (.als) in it and spots the plugins missing on this Mac.
exact.Sans elles, ReAble ne sait convertir auc: Without them, ReAble cannot convert any plugin. Sync them with the “reable plugins sync” command, then restart the app.
exact.ReAble lit chaque projet sans le modifie: ReAble reads each project without changing it. You can stop at any time.
exact.ReAble simule chaque conversion, sans ri: ReAble simulates each conversion without writing anything. You can stop at any time.
exact.Cochez les conversions à lancer. Rien n’: Tick the conversions to run. Nothing is written until you click Convert.
Your settings will be carried over.
exact.Repart des réglages par défaut ; l’ancie: Starts from default settings; the old preset is noted on the track.

exact.Les copies existent déjà ; elles ne sero: The copies already exist; they won’t be redone.

exact.Essai à blanc terminé : rien n'a été écr: Dry run finished: nothing was written.
exact.Les copies sont à côté des originaux, av: The copies are next to the originals, with [ReAble] in their name. Your originals were not modified.
exact.Ouvrez une copie : les pistes dupliquées: Open a copy: duplicated tracks load their instrument, the original is muted; the new effect plugin is placed before the old one, which is disabled.
exact.« Reprendre » continue avec les projets: “Resume” continues with the remaining projects without redoing the first ones. “Undo what was done” moves the copies to the Trash and leaves your original projects untouched.
exact.Aucun projet de ce dossier ne contient d: No project in this folder contains a missing plugin that ReAble can replace.

exact.Plugin inconnu de ReAble : il n'est pas: Plugin unknown to ReAble: it isn’t supported yet
exact.À tester dans l'onglet Plugins avant de: Test it in the Plugins tab before it can be converted
exact.Pas de version VST3 compatible installée: No compatible VST3 version installed on this Mac
exact.Par quel plugin installé en VST3 ? Cela: Which VST3 plugin should replace it? This works both for a plugin that was renamed (Play became Opus) and for a different plugin that does the same job.
exact.Aucun plugin VST3 n’est connu : il faut: No VST3 plugin is known: a Live 12 project containing the replacement plugin as VST3 (a “template”) is needed. Add one from the Review screen.
exact.Le preset et les réglages ne sont pas tr: Presets and settings can’t be transferred from one plugin to another: the replacement starts with its default settings, and the old preset’s name is noted on the track. The old plugin’s automations are not carried over.
exact.Reprend le preset et les réglages (forma: Keeps the preset and settings (iZotope format)
exact.Vérifiez que le plugin se charge, avec l: Check that the plugin loads, with the same preset and settings as the original project. Play a few notes or listen to the track.
exact.Trois étapes. Le résultat reste sur ce M: Three steps. The result stays on this Mac: nothing is sent without your consent.
exact.Aidez à enrichir la bibliothèque : ReAbl: Help grow the library: ReAble can prepare an anonymous file with your plugin test results (no project, track or path names). You send it yourself, if you wish.
exact.Aucun résultat à exporter : testez d’abo: No result to export: test a plugin from the Plugins tab first.
exact.Pour convertir vers un plugin, ReAble a: To convert to a plugin, ReAble needs a Live 12 project that contains it as VST3. It keeps a copy at each analysis; you can add more from the Review screen.
exact.Choisissez la langue de l’interface. « A: Choose the interface language. “Automatic” follows the macOS language.
exact.Retrouve et répare les plugins manquants: Finds and fixes the missing plugins in your Ableton Live projects. Your original projects are never modified.
exact.Version bêta : vérifiez chaque conversio: Beta version: check every conversion in Live before relying on it.
